Markus — reviewed the SLA tweak. I made one small change to the fallback clause that preserves the commercial commitment while limiting exposure. Language below (ready to insert into the SOW):

"Fallback: In the event of measurable latency degradation affecting >15% of production requests over a rolling 24-hour window, Redwood will provide a prioritized mitigation plan and may provision a temporary instance at Redwood expense for up to 72 hours to restore baseline latency. Customer remedies are limited to credits described in Section 5."

If BrightCart legal accepts that phrase, we can move forward. I uploaded a clean redline (redlines_markus_20270506.pdf) with the insertion highlighted.

I approve sending DocuSign tonight.

Kimberly Park
